scenarios.text_scenario: A festival is coming and everyone is travelling home, so you want to book before seats run out.
examples: Tyohar aa raha hai, jagah pehle le lo
Seats khatam hone se pehle karwa do
Bhid hone wali hai, abhi karwao

scenarios.text_scenario: You are travelling overnight and want a sleeper berth.
examples: Raat wali gaadi mein sona hai
Sone wali jagah chahiye raat ke liye
Overnight safar ke liye karwa do

scenarios.text_scenario: Four of you are travelling together and want seats side by side.
examples: Char log hain, saath mein chahiye
Hum sab ek jagah baithenge
Group ke liye karwa do saath

scenarios.text_scenario: Someone at home fell ill and you can no longer travel.
examples: Ghar mein tabiyat kharab hai, nahi ja sakta
Ab jaana nahi ho payega, hata do
Yatra radd karni padegi

scenarios.text_scenario: You booked two options and now want to drop the one you will not use.
examples: Do karwa liye the, ek hata do
Jo nahi chahiye wo radd karo
Extra wala nikal do

scenarios.text_scenario: You have been on the waiting list for days and the journey is tomorrow.
examples: Kal nikalna hai, list se upar aaya kya?
Abhi tak pakka hua ya nahi?
Intezaar wali list mein kahan hoon?

scenarios.text_scenario: Your family member is travelling and you want to check on their behalf.
examples: Papa ki booking pakki hui kya dekho
Unka number daal ke check karo
Ghar walon ka pata karo confirm hai ya nahi

scenarios.text_scenario: You have been standing on the platform for an hour with no announcement.
examples: Ek ghanta ho gaya khade khade, kahan hai?
Koi announcement nahi, pata karo
Aa bhi rahi hai ya nahi?

scenarios.text_scenario: You are tracking a relative's journey to know when to leave to collect them.
examples: Kab tak pahunchegi wo, batao
Mujhe nikalna kab chahiye lene?
Abhi kis jagah tak aayi hai?

scenarios.text_scenario: You are on a tight budget and want to know the cheapest way to travel.
examples: Sabse sasta kaunsa padega?
Kam paise mein kaise ja sakte hain?
Budget kitna lagega poore safar ka?

scenarios.text_scenario: You want to know if a child travels at a reduced rate.
examples: Bachhe ka aadha lagta hai kya?
Chhote bachhe ke liye kitna?
Bachhon ka rate alag hota hai?

scenarios.text_scenario: You decided to travel at the last moment and are hoping something is still free.
examples: Achanak plan bana, kuch bacha hai?
Last moment mein mil jayega?
Aaj hi nikalna hai, jagah hai?

scenarios.text_scenario: You want to sit with an elderly parent who cannot climb to an upper berth.
examples: Maa ke liye neeche wali chahiye
Upar nahi chadh payenge wo
Buzurg ke liye kya available hai?

scenarios.text_scenario: Your meeting got postponed so your travel must shift too.
examples: Meeting aage badh gayi, safar bhi badlo
Tarikh aage karni hai ab
Do din baad ka kar do

scenarios.text_scenario: Bad weather is forecast and you want to travel a day earlier instead.
examples: Mausam kharab hoga, ek din pehle nikal jaun
Pehle wale din shift kar do
Jaldi wala kar do isko

scenarios.text_scenario: The journey was cancelled by the operator, not by you, and you expect your money back.
examples: Unhone radd kiya tha, paisa wapas do
Meri galti nahi thi, poora milna chahiye
Unki taraf se cancel hua, kya milega?

scenarios.text_scenario: You want to know how long the money usually takes to come back.
examples: Kitne din lagte hain paisa aane mein?
Normally kab tak wapas aata hai?
Prakriya mein kitna samay lagega?

scenarios.text_scenario: It is late at night and you need a safe ride home.
examples: Raat bahut ho gayi, ghar pahuncha do
Safe gaadi bhejo is waqt
Der ho gayi, koi sawari bhejo

scenarios.text_scenario: You are carrying heavy luggage and need a larger vehicle.
examples: Bahut saman hai, badi gaadi bhejo
Luggage zyada hai, chhoti nahi chalegi
Bade wali gaadi chahiye samaan ke liye

scenarios.text_scenario: You want to know the first service of the morning so you can plan an early start.
examples: Subah sabse pehli kaunsi hai?
Din ki shuruat mein kab chalti hai?
Sabse jaldi wali ka samay batao

scenarios.text_scenario: You want to know how frequently services run on this route.
examples: Kitni kitni der mein aati hai?
Har ghante hai ya kam?
Is raste pe kitni baar chalti hai?

scenarios.text_scenario: Speaker talks about something personal unrelated to travel.
examples: Tabiyat theek nahi lag rahi
Kal bahut kaam tha office mein
Chai pi lete hain pehle

scenarios.text_scenario: Speaker asks something from another domain — banking, education, or assistant.
examples: Kisht kitni baaki hai meri?
Ye sawaal hal kar do
Gaana badal do agla

scenarios.text_scenario: Speaker gives filler or an unfinished sentence.
examples: Haan wo bhi hai
Ek minute sochne do
Chhodo koi baat nahi
